page.overview:
Who is Avila?

Avila was a Truthsayer and member of the Sisterhood.

While Avila was training on Wallach IX, there was a conflict after Raquella's death because some remained loyal to Dorotea, whom they believed killed herself after Raquella's death, and others who followed Valya. Valya and some of those loyal to her came to those loyal to Dorotea, including Avila, and ordered them to follow Valya or kill themselves as Dorotea had. When they were finished, only Avila remained and she agreed to cover up what had happened there.

Avila came to Valya to review the day's requests from the Great Houses. Valya told her which requests to grant and which to deny.

Avila talked to Tula about the decision to put Lila through the Agony to get information. Tula was resistant, but knew it was Valya's order, so she went through it. They watched as Raquella spoke through Lila and then collapsed, limp and unresponsive.
